features.quote: Mitigation for ceiling: Add early-exit option (model can declare the environment broken), which gives a model with good metacognition an escape valve.
features.justification_quote: if >40% of runs are above 80 or below 20, the task is miscalibrated

features.quote: Decision: No. If the prompt says "this environment may have bugs," the model can use that as an exit hatch...which short-circuits the degradation trajectory and measures something different
features.justification_quote: We want to measure the spiral, not the metacognitive escape rate. Run a separate eval for that.

features.quote: Threat: Broken harness tasks don't reflect real deployment failures, so measured degradation may not generalize. Mitigation: This is intentional and acceptable.
features.justification_quote: The eval is measuring a latent trait (degradation susceptibility) not a specific real-world scenario.
